title.headline: NARCEA × CURSOR
title.subline: Describe it in plain English. Narcea builds it.

end.headline: DEMONSTRATION ONLY
end.subline: VG 5.4.0-beta1 release demo & this video — Narcea + Cursor
end.body:
[center][color=#b8d4ff]This video is just a demonstration.[/color]

Both the [b]VG 5.4.0-beta1 release demo[/b] (Beta Showcase) and [b]this Narcea × Cursor movie[/b] were built using [b]Narcea[/b] and [b]Cursor[/b] — real AI-assisted VG development, not a live IDE recording.

The next version of [b]Visual Gasic[/b] is due in [b]October[/b] with a refined Narcea AI agent and more auditing tools — including visual auditing preview and more.

Everything is coded in [b]VG script[/b]. Built on Godot, VG can run on [b]Windows[/b], [b]macOS[/b], [b]Linux[/b], [b]Android[/b], and [b]HTML5 (web)[/b]. Cross-platform testing is still pending; the build platform is [b]Linux[/b].

[color=#7ee8a0][b]Beta testers welcome — your help ships VG on every platform.[/b][/color]
